Implemented in `/workspace/output`:

- CLI and process orchestration in [src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)
- BibTeX-style parsing and symbol handling in [src/style.rs](/workspace/output/src/style.rs) and [src/bib.rs](/workspace/output/src/bib.rs)
- Stack-machine runtime and built-ins in [src/runtime.rs](/workspace/output/src/runtime.rs)
- Structured JSON serialization in [src/json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs)
- `.bbl` line wrapping/output buffering in [src/output_buf.rs](/workspace/output/src/output_buf.rs)

`cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` succeeds, and I smoke-tested the tool against `plain.bst` with a sample `.bib` to confirm it produces a `.bbl` and structured log JSON.

If you want a broader parity pass next, the natural follow-up is a corpus compare against real BibTeX outputs on more `.bib`/`.bst` cases.
